usage: Usually refers to the thick main stem of a tree; a very common noun in gardening, nature, and basic science talk.
Often used with verbs like 睇, 摸, 量, 砍, or 受傷 when talking about the tree itself or damage to it.
Can appear in compound words and descriptive phrases, for example to talk about the size, shape, or texture of the trunk.
Natural in both everyday Cantonese and school-level vocabulary; when speaking casually, people may also use the shorter tree-related term rather than a technical phrase.
